get.summary: Read a device metric as bucketed points

parameters.description: The metric to read

parameters.description: Range start, epoch milliseconds, inclusive

parameters.description: Range end, epoch milliseconds, exclusive

parameters.description: Bucket width in seconds. Default 60.

parameters.description: `locf` carries the last observation forward across empty buckets

payload.description: The team's settings: a JSON object, encoded as a string

memberId.description: The caller's membership in this team

permissions.description: What the caller can do in this team: their role, lowered to a token's ceiling

id.description: The invite's id: the invited membership's id

role.description: The token's role ceiling; null means the creator's current role

permissions.description: What the token can do now: its creator's current role lowered to its ceiling. Listed tokens only.

deviceTotal.description: The space's live devices. Absent when listing a zone's spaces.

open.description: Whether the zone accepts new spaces in this environment

authorityId.description: The authority that issued a cert credential

certFingerprint.description: SHA-256 of a cert credential's certificate

rotatedFrom.description: The credential this one replaced on rotation

secret.description: The bearer token (the MQTT password), shown only once

certificatePem.description: The signed device certificate, shown only once

code.description: The claim code, shown only once

config.description: The trigger or step's own settings, shaped by its type
The trigger or step's own settings, shaped by its type
The trigger or step's own settings, shaped by its type

chain.description: Ordered condition and action steps; at least one action

templateDrift.description: On a single read of a template-built automation: true when its chain no longer matches its template

secret.description: The bearer secret; shown once, never retrievable again

layout.description: Placement in grid cells: x and y not negative, w and h positive

source.description: What the widget shows: an `automationId` for an automation widget, else a `deviceId` or a `capability`

spaceId.description: The space it is scoped to; null for team-wide

evidence.description: The fact the result rests on, in plain words

parkedAt.description: Set while the device is parked: it cannot connect or write

online.description: Whether the device was seen within the offline window

duplicate.description: True when the dedup key was already used: no second command was sent

payload.description: The account's settings: a JSON object, encoded as a string

thisDevice.description: Whether this is the session making the request

actorId.description: The member or device that acted; null for the system

targetKind.description: What the action acted on, e.g. `device`

buffer.description: Headroom past `limit` before events are refused. Events only.

month.description: The month usage counts over: `YYYY-MM`, UTC

limitGrace.description: Set while a post-downgrade over-limit grace period runs

registeredDevices.description: The ceiling on active plus parked devices

monthlyTotal.description: The plan's monthly price with add-ons, in USD

totalC.description: The invoice total in minor units

payload.description: The invoice detail: a JSON object, encoded as a string

amountDue.description: What the change bills now, in minor units; negative for a credit

nextPaymentAttempt.description: When the change is billed, in Unix seconds

month.description: The month usage counts over: `YYYY-MM`, UTC

limitGrace.description: Set while a post-downgrade over-limit grace period runs

registeredDevices.description: The ceiling on active plus parked devices

subsystem.description: The first subsystem that failed its probe; set only when `down`

value.description: The bucket's aggregate. Null for a gap with no prior observation, and for the first bucket of a delta or rate series.

spaceId.description: A space id; null or empty clears the scope

chain.description: Ordered condition and action steps; at least one action

template.description: A template reference; set by the platform on template-built automations
A template id to re-expand the chain from; exclusive with `payload`

params.description: The template's slot values, keyed by slot name; used with `template`

UpdateAutomationRequest.description: At least one of name, spaceId, payload or template

spaceId.description: A space id to scope the dashboard to; null or empty for team-wide

payload.description: Replaces every widget; null for none

spaceId.description: A space in the device's zone

tier.description: The paid tier to move to

kind.description: `platform` generates a managed CA; `byo` registers the team's own

spaceId.description: A space id; null, empty or absent for a team-wide automation

chain.description: Ordered condition and action steps; at least one action

template.description: A template reference; set by the platform on template-built automations

params.description: The template's slot values, keyed by slot name

TriggerAutomationRequest.description: Optional context for the chain: a JSON object. Any other body, or none, is ignored.

csrPem.description: The device's PEM certificate signing request

spaceId.description: A space id to scope the dashboard to; null or empty for team-wide

payload.description: The widgets; null or absent for none

capability.description: The capability key the device declared

dedupKey.description: Caller-owned idempotency key: reuse it on retry so the device fires once

expiresInMinutes.description: How long the code can be claimed. Default 1440 (24 hours).

email.description: The email of an existing account

BadRequest.description: The request is malformed or fails validation.

Unauthorized.description: No valid API token or session.

Forbidden.description: The caller's role does not allow this.

NotFound.description: The resource does not exist or is not visible.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with the resource's state.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests. Retry after `Retry-After` seconds.

BackendUnavailable.description: A backend is unavailable (`backend_unavailable`). Retry after `Retry-After` seconds.

apiToken.description: An API token, created with `POST /api-tokens` and pinned to one team.
